description_en: Retrieves the interval statistical reports for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListIntervalInstanceReport获取指定实例的分段统计报表
name: ListIntervalInstanceReport

parameters.help_en: The start time in UNIX timestamp format, measured in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. Default value: 00:00:00 of the current day. The statistical time precision is in hours. The time is rounded down to the nearest hour, and the start time is inclusive
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time in UNIX timestamp format, measured in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. Default value: the current time. If Interval is set to Daily, the maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime is 180 days. If Interval is set to Hourly, the maximum interval is 10 days. The statistical time precision is in hours. The time is rounded up to the nearest hour, and the end time is exclusive. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the aligned time range is [11:00:00, 12:00:00), which means greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认是当前时间，如果Interval为Daily，StartTime和EndTime最大间隔是180天。如果Interval为Hourly，最大间隔时间为10天。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The type of interval statistics. This parameter is optional. Default value: Daily, which indicates daily aggregation
parameters.help_zh: 分段统计类型，非必填，默认为Daily（按天汇总）
parameters.name: interval

Data.description_en: The list of segmented statistics for the instance
Data.description_zh: 实例分段统计数据列表

items.description_en: The segmented statistics for the instance

AbandonRate.description_en: The abandon rate. Formula: CallsAbandoned/CallsOffered. The result may exceed 100% in some cases because abandon events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges
AbandonRate.description_zh: 放弃率。计算公式为：CallsAbandoned/CallsOffered（由于放弃事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AbandonedRate.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated. Refer to AbandonRate
AbandonedRate.description_zh: 已废弃，该字段可以参考AbandonRate

AverageAbandonTime.description_en: The average abandon time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalAbandonTime/CallsAbandoned
AverageAbandonTime.description_zh: 平均放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonTime/CallsAbandoned

AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: The average IVR abandon time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalAbandonedInIVRTime/CallsAbandonedInIVR
AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description_zh: 平均IVR放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInIVRTime/CallsAbandonedInIVR

AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: The average queue abandon time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalAbandonedInQueueTime/CallsAbandonedInQueue
AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 平均排队放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInQueueTime/CallsAbandonedInQueue

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: The average ring abandon time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime/CallsAbandonedInRing
AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInRingTime/CallsAbandonedInRing

AverageFirstResponseTime.description_en: The average first response time for chat sessions. Unit: seconds
AverageFirstResponseTime.description_zh: Chat会话平均首次响应时长，单位为秒

AverageHoldTime.description_en: The average hold time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalHoldTime/CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageResponseTime.description_en: The average response time for chat sessions

AverageRingTime.description_en: The average ring time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalRingTime/CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: The average talk time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled

AverageWaitTime.description_en: The average wait time, which is the average time a customer waits before an agent answers the call. Formula: TotalWaitTime/CallsHandled
AverageWaitTime.description_zh: 平均等待时长，平均每通电话的坐席接起前等待时长。计算公式为： TotalWaitTime/CallsHandled

AverageWorkTime.description_en: The average after-call work time. Unit: seconds. Formula: TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled

CallsAbandoned.description_en: The number of abandoned calls. Formula: CallsAbandonedInIVR + CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing

CallsAbandonedInIVR.description_en: The number of calls abandoned in the IVR, which is the number of calls hung up by customers during the IVR process after entering the IVR flow
CallsAbandonedInIVR.description_zh: IVR放弃量，即电话进入IVR流程之后在IVR环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_en: The number of calls abandoned in the queue, which is the number of calls hung up by customers during the queuing process after entering the queue
CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_zh: 队列放弃量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInRing.description_en: The number of calls abandoned during ringing, which is the number of calls hung up by customers while agents were ringing
CallsAbandonedInRing.description_zh: 振铃放弃量，即坐席振铃中客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description_en: The number of calls abandoned in the intelligent navigation module
CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description_zh: 通话在智能导航模块放弃的数量

CallsAttendedTransferred.description_en: The number of attended transfers, which is the number of calls that were attended transferred. If a call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsAttendedTransferred.description_zh: 咨询转接量，即发生咨询转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsBlindTransferred.description_en: The number of blind transfers, which is the number of calls that were blind transferred. If a call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsBlindTransferred.description_zh: 直接转接量，即发生直接转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsCausedIVRException.description_en: The number of calls that caused IVR exceptions

CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description_en: The number of calls forwarded to external numbers
CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description_zh: 发生转外线的通话数量

CallsHandled.description_en: The number of handled calls, which is the number of calls answered by agents. If a call is answered by multiple agents, it is counted as one
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即坐席应答的电话数量。若一通电话被多个坐席应答，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: The number of held calls, which is the number of calls placed on hold. If a call is placed on hold multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。若一通电话保持多次，算一次

CallsIVRException.description_en: The number of calls with IVR exceptions. An exception occurs when the IVR enters a hang-up cause node and the hang-up cause is set to transfer to agent failure. In this case, the count increases by 1
CallsIVRException.description_zh: 发生IVR异常的通话数量，判定条件是IVR进入了挂机原因节点且挂机原因节点设置的挂机原因为转人工失败，此时计数加1

CallsOffered.description_en: The number of inbound calls to the Cloud Call Center
CallsOffered.description_zh: 呼入到云联络中心的电话数量

CallsQueued.description_en: The number of calls that entered the queue. If a call enters the queue multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsQueued.description_zh: 进入队列的电话数量，若一通电话多次进入队列，算一次

CallsQueuingFailed.description_en: The number of queuing failures, which is the number of calls hung up by customers during the queuing process after entering the queue
CallsQueuingFailed.description_zh: 队列失败量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsQueuingOverflow.description_en: The number of queue overflows, which is the number of calls that overflowed while queuing in the IVR
CallsQueuingOverflow.description_zh: 队列溢出的通话数量，即通话在IVR排队时队列溢出

CallsQueuingTimeout.description_en: The number of calls that timed out during the queuing phase
CallsQueuingTimeout.description_zh: 在排队阶段超时的通话数量

CallsRinged.description_en: The number of calls that rang on agent devices. If a call is assigned to multiple agents and rings, it is counted as one
CallsRinged.description_zh: 座席振铃的电话数量，若一通电话分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

CallsToVoicemail.description_en: The number of calls transferred to voice mail
CallsToVoicemail.description_zh: 转入语音信箱的电话数量

CallsVoicemail.description_en: The number of calls routed to voice mail
CallsVoicemail.description_zh: 通话进入语音留言信箱的数量

HandleRate.description_en: The answer rate. Formula: CallsHandled/CallsOffered. The result may exceed 100% in some cases because answer events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges
HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled/CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

CallsBlindTransferred.description_en: The number of blind transfers, which is the number of calls that were blind transferred. If a call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one

CallsHold.description_en: The number of held calls, which is the number of calls placed on hold. If a call is placed on hold multiple times, it is counted as one
